The following events took place in '''3628''' '''[['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Order of Zildrog]] is defeated on [[Nathema]].<ref name="TOR:TNC">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref>
*The Sith Empire [[Invasion of Ossus|attacks]] a [[Jedi Colony|hidden Jedi Colony]] on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. [[Darth Malgus]] is revealed to be alive.<ref name="TOR:TFC" />
*The [[third Galactic War]] breaks out between the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR:TFC" />
